# Pact Raven

Pact Raven is a commitment and accountability product for users in India. Users create a pact, choose their own amount and number of days, lock money behind it, show proof, and receive refund credit when proof is approved. Missed or rejected days forfeit to Akshaya Patra, not Pact Raven revenue.

## Core model

- Lock money. Show proof daily. Missed days fund Akshaya Patra.
- Pact Raven starts with workout pacts and content pacts.
- Every Pact Pass is free. You choose the deposit amount and the number of days.
- A Pact Pass unlocks one pact record. The separate pact deposit is refundable only through approved proof and manual settlement rules.
- Workout proof requires fresh in-app camera capture, captured device location, and the daily physical prompt.
- Content proof requires a public post link that matches the pact rules.
- Approved proof creates refund credit for manual UPI payout.
- Missed, late, unclear, private, deleted, or rejected proof may forfeit the related deposit credit to Akshaya Patra.
- Pact Raven is currently a beta for India-based users who are at least 18 years old.
- Approved refund credit is available for manual UPI payout after approval. Users may submit up to two manual withdrawal requests per week.
- Akshaya Patra is the charity destination for forfeited amounts, not a formal Pact Raven charity partner unless stated otherwise. Forfeited amounts are transferred in monthly batches.
